title: From Ideas to Actions: A Public-Data Decision-Support Toolchain Across the Venture Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2609.15219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Founders face two linked decisions: whether to pursue an idea before founding, and which operating actions and capital partners fit afterward. We present a public-data decision-support toolchain combining time-bounded proposal profiling, market and moat checks, and deterministic aggregation with auditable investor-company event chains for retrospective analysis. Pre-founding: (a) After threshold selection on 198 development companies, the frozen pipeline achieves F0.5=0.5357 [0.412, 0.655] on an independent, row-disjoint 198-company validation sample. On the combined 396 rows, the Full Pipeline scores 0.6301 versus 0.2734 for a paired Raw LLM baseline. Post-stratification of 1,027 completed cases in a separate scale cohort yields 0.6506 [0.598, 0.707]; the run remains incomplete. A 377-row composition-matched check yields 0.6573. translated_title: 从创意到行动：贯穿创业生命周期的公开数据决策支持工具链
translated_abstract: 创始人面临两个相互关联的决策：在创立公司之前是否 pursue 某个创意，以及之后采取哪些运营行动和选择哪些资本合作伙伴。我们提出了一个基于公开数据的决策支持工具链，该工具链结合了有严格时限的提案画像、市场与护城河核查，以及带有可审计的投资方-公司事件链的确定性聚合方法，用于回溯性分析。创立前阶段：(a) 在198家开发公司上进行阈值筛选后，冻结的流程在一个独立的、行互不重叠的198家公司验证样本上取得了F0.5=0.5357 [0.412, 0.655] 的成绩。在合并的396行数据上，完整流程得分为0.6301，而配对的原始LLM基线仅为0.2734。在另一个规模化队列中，对1,027个已完成案例进行事后分层得到0.6506 [0.598, 0.707]；该运行尚未完成。一项377行的组成匹配检查得到0.6573。(b) AI推理研究识别出分销层业务是通往独立盈利的可复制路径……
tldr: 该论文构建了一个基于公开数据、贯穿创业全生命周期的决策支持工具链，可在创立前评估创意可行性、创立后匹配运营行动与资本伙伴，其性能（0.6301）显著优于原始LLM基线（0.2734）。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a public-data decision-support toolchain spanning the venture lifecycle that helps founders evaluate ideas pre-founding and match operating actions with capital partners post-founding, significantly outperforming a raw LLM baseline (0.6301 vs 0.2734).
